title: TradeThesis — Support & Resistance
status: first-pass implementation handoff; not implemented or approved for release
workflow: Complete first pass; defer course-wide review to SECOND_PASS_REVIEW_REGISTER.md.
content_principle: Observation → interpretation → conditional scenario → invalidation/reconsideration. Unclear and stand-aside are valid conclusions where supported.

lessons.title: What support and resistance actually tell you
lessons.learner_goal: Understand support/resistance as areas where responses may occur, not promises.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Observe → compare a candidate area → reveal the label → revisit uncertainty.
lessons.submission_requirement: Two practice states; learner may identify a broad area or say the evidence is ambiguous.
lessons.special_rules: Observation before terminology; no prediction or signal.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Read structure before drawing
lessons.learner_goal: Describe rising, falling, ranging, transitional or unclear structure before adding zones.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Label broad structure → reveal candidate turning points → compare an early chart state with later evidence.
lessons.submission_requirement: Learner chooses a structure description and states what remains uncertain.
lessons.special_rules: Do not begin by drawing many zones.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Identify meaningful swing points
lessons.learner_goal: Select consequential swings without marking every local turn.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Inspect clean chart → identify candidate turns → reveal reference points → compare a simplified view.
lessons.submission_requirement: Free response or annotation; reference accepts defensible alternatives.
lessons.special_rules: The reference points are one reasoned example, not the only correct set.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Zones, not perfect lines
lessons.learner_goal: Use a band that accounts for related reactions instead of demanding one exact price.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Compare boundary candidates → choose and explain a band → reveal why too narrow/broad examples differ.
lessons.submission_requirement: Learner records the evidence used for the upper/lower boundary.
lessons.special_rules: Use same chart scale for comparisons; do not grade pixel-perfect boundaries.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Choose the right areas and reduce clutter
lessons.learner_goal: Prioritise useful areas and remove low-value marks.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Review an overmarked chart → select candidate IDs → edit/remove → submit → enter ChartLab Clear W.
lessons.submission_requirement: Only planned ChartLab #1: Clear W. Keep student drawing until reference reveal.
lessons.special_rules: Do not add further ChartLab activities.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Set defensible zone boundaries
lessons.learner_goal: Explain boundary choice with visible reactions, wicks and bodies.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Observe → identify reaction points → compare too-narrow/defensible/too-broad → independent attempt.
lessons.submission_requirement: Learner explains why the zone includes/excludes evidence.
lessons.special_rules: Reasoning matters more than one exact coordinate.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Keep the chart readable
lessons.learner_goal: Remove marks that do not improve explanation.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Start overmarked → merge redundant areas → discuss contextual omissions → compare clean final → independent edit.
lessons.submission_requirement: Learner names which marks were removed and why.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Evaluate a zone without inventing a magic score
lessons.learner_goal: Review zone relevance contextually, not with a universal numeric score.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Compare repeated crossings with more interpretable reactions → defend qualitative judgement → enter ChartLab Uneven Lows.
lessons.submission_requirement: Only planned ChartLab #2: Uneven Lows. Reference is explanatory, not predictive scoring.
lessons.special_rules: Touch count alone is not a quality score.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Read the approach to a zone
lessons.learner_goal: Describe approach behaviour before the zone is reached; separate observation from interpretation.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Use synthetic directional/overlapping approaches → learner records observation and alternative → short instructor micro-case inserted when supplied.
lessons.submission_requirement: Do not substitute synthetic charts for the promised instructor case. Keep learner-facing crop before interaction and hide markings/outcome.
lessons.special_rules: Authentic chart and actual rationale remain an input dependency.
lessons.status: Partially blocked by authentic instructor material

lessons.title: Rejection versus acceptance
lessons.learner_goal: Distinguish a reaction away, sustained movement beyond, and inconclusive evidence.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Reveal one candle/event at a time → learner classifies current evidence → continue reveal → compare practice sequences.
lessons.submission_requirement: Answer options: reaction, possible acceptance, or inconclusive; explain evidence rather than force a binary.
lessons.special_rules: A single wick or candle is not universal proof.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: How a zone’s significance changes
lessons.learner_goal: Update a zone assessment when new evidence accumulates or weakens.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Step through timeline → update evidence log at each stage → compare conclusions over time.
lessons.submission_requirement: Learner must state what changed and what did not.
lessons.special_rules: Do not use touch count as a stand-alone ranking.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Breakout or temporary penetration?
lessons.learner_goal: Distinguish brief crossings from more sustained movement beyond a zone.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Show first crossing → pause and request current read → reveal return or follow-through → independent practice.
lessons.submission_requirement: Each reveal allows updated judgement, including “not enough evidence yet.”
lessons.special_rules: No hindsight in the initial view.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Retests and role reversal
lessons.learner_goal: Treat return tests and role reversal as possibilities, not requirements.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Reveal break → return to former area → compare hold and failure cases → write conditions that would change view.
lessons.submission_requirement: Learner compares a holding and failed return rather than memorising one rule.
lessons.special_rules: A retest is not mandatory; role reversal is not guaranteed.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Failed breakouts and alternate outcomes
lessons.learner_goal: Analyse a failed break without hindsight and consider alternate paths.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Observe pre-break chart → reveal first move beyond → reveal return through → compare with pullback-holds example → ChartLab Wider Neckline.
lessons.submission_requirement: Only planned ChartLab #3: Wider Neckline. Preserve the “before” state without the later break visible.
lessons.special_rules: Keep alternate outcomes visible in the lesson.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: From zones to conditional scenarios
lessons.learner_goal: Write if/then scenarios, invalidation, alternatives and available space.
lessons.interaction_pattern: View chart without zones → identify zones → reveal scenario prompt → complete scenario card → independent practice.
lessons.submission_requirement: Accept two conditional scenarios or one scenario plus a justified stand-aside conclusion.
lessons.special_rules: This is analysis practice, not an entry signal or sizing calculator.
lessons.status: Draft specification; map against live UI in implementation pass

lessons.title: Case study: a trade based on a reaction
lessons.learner_goal: Review a real reaction-based trade chronologically and separate process from outcome.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Context and pre-trade view → thesis/alternative/invalidation → trigger and risk → management/exit → review, revealing only after earlier decisions.
lessons.submission_requirement: Build the lesson shell and stage slots now; populate only when user supplies original records. Any reconstruction must be labelled.
lessons.special_rules: Do not fabricate charts, instrument, prices, rationale or trade outcome.

lessons.title: When the thesis fails, or you stay out
lessons.learner_goal: Review an authentic failed thesis, loss or justified stand-aside; distinguish thesis failure from process failure.

lessons.submission_requirement: Provide a stand-instruction shell only; do not synthesize a personal case.

lessons.learner_goal: Independently apply the full method to an unfamiliar chart.
lessons.interaction_pattern: Unseen chart → submit structure/zones/reasoning/scenarios/invalidation/space → only then reveal reference and score → parallel unseen retry if needed.
